title: aetheolaena otophora var. microcephala
intro: Aetheolaena otophora var. microcephala, commonly known as Otophora, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aetheolaena otophora var. microcephala are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
